ABOUT VISIONAIRE

Laboratory engineering from Bengaluru, India. Since March 2007.

NEARLY 20 YEARS IN THE MAKING

Precision in every detail.
Purpose in every space.

Visionaire Lab Systems Pvt. Ltd. manufactures laboratory equipment and furniture, with a focus on fume hoods, laminar air flow systems and bio-safety cabinets.

Our work spans research and technology centres, CROs, pilot plants, scale-up labs and kilo labs. We connect planning and design with manufacturing and installation to deliver complete laboratory environments.

OUR VISION

Clean, safe spaces.
New possibilities.

Engineering for discovery

To support laboratory innovation through quality equipment, thoughtful engineering and a clean working environment.

From Bengaluru, with expertise

Our administrative office is in Vijayanagar, with manufacturing at the KIADB Industrial Area on Jigani–Bommasandra Link Road.
